summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of the shared PhaseDetailModal across Phase Predictor, Dashboard, and MoodMap. All 6 acceptance criteria PASS. Verified data-testid='phase-detail-dialog' renders in all three entry points with identical structure: header (emoji + phase.name + Days range) → punchline (italic DialogDescription) → Play-by-Play → What She Feels (Physical + Mental/Emotional) → Prep (collapsible) → Action (collapsible). Predictor Menstrual card header='🧸 Menstrual / Days 1–5' with punchline='Recovery Week: She’s running on empty.' (NOT the punchline as title). Predictor PMS card header='⚠️ PMS / Days 24–28' with punchline='High-alert week! Sensitivity’s up.'. MoodMap Menstrual legend opens identical modal with same header. Dashboard 'See Full Details' opens the same shared PhaseDetailModal (showed Follicular for day-8 seeded partner with header='🌷 Follicular / Days 6–13'). Both collapsible-prep and collapsible-action testids present in all three contexts.
